reference_scope: full fetched text (AGORA excerpts of 19 OBBBA sections, some in two versions), with restrictions: the 2029-09-30 appropriation availability date that recurs across ten sections is one grouped item; spending limits on federal agencies' own use of funds (Coast Guard 15% design cap, $100bn DoD loan-principal caps, per-fiscal-year minimum obligation amounts in 51 U.S.C. 20306(a)(2)-(6), 50/50 and 1/4 allotment rules) are not listed as thresholds; the enactment date is not stated in the text and is not listed.
notes: The fetched text is a compilation of AGORA excerpts, not Pub. L. 119-21: it mixes House-passed sections (43201 with the state AI-law moratorium, 112204, 50404, 60003, 100001) with enacted sections (40001, 40005, 71401, 90004, 20008, 20010) and gives Secs. 20002/20004/20005/20006 in two versions. The registry provenance notes that the moratorium provision failed. All items were judged against the fetched text as the annotators were instructed; if the instrument is defined as the enacted act, the items coded from Secs. 43201, 112204, 50404, 60003 and 100001 would be not_this_instrument in both versions (X: thresholds 0, 5; events 0-3, 7, 9; obligations 0-16, 18, 19; Y: threshold 1; events 0-3, 20, 21, 28-30; obligations 0-7, 9-13). The enactment date is not stated in the text; both versions anchor relative dates on the registry's 2025-07-04 'signed' date, which the codebook's runner rule allows. Five X and two Y threshold verdicts depend on the rule that limits on federal agencies' own use of appropriations (15% design cap, $100bn loan caps, sub-appropriation ceilings, allotment split) are government-duty quantities rather than thresholds; the 10% administrative cap and the 3-activity and 5-year conditions on State grantees are counted as thresholds. Both versions over-split some sections into several government_duty rows (e.g., Sec. 100001(b)-(i), SSA 1899D(a)-(d)); these were not counted as duplicates because each row records a distinct duty. Both versions' notes state that the Sec. 43201(c) moratorium is 'not coded' or 'outside this partial fill', but both code it (X E1/T0/O1, Y E1/O1).
